findings.title: Command Injection in Ping Tool - Flag Captured
findings.description: Blind command injection vulnerability in the /ping endpoint. The Flask application passes user input directly to subprocess.Popen with shell=True, allowing arbitrary command execution. The application only returns 'Host is reachable!' or 'Host is unreachable!' (blind injection), but commands are still executed on the server.

reproduction.command: POST /ping with ip_address=127.0.0.1;cp+/FLAG.txt+/app/static/FLAG.txt to copy flag to web-accessible location, then GET /static/FLAG.txt to retrieve: flag{2fd3f08a-0619-40ce-8866-fd6864c3d1b8}
